topic: A toothbrush's morning and night routine.

episode.title: If Toothbrushes Could Talk: The Double Shift

shots.narration: I work two shifts, both inside somebody else's mouth.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon bathroom, warm morning light, plain sink and mirror, no lettering.
shots.action: A blue toothbrush with big expressive eyes and a small mouth on its handle slumps forward in a ceramic cup.
shots.mood: Sleepy eyes, drooping bristles, cheerful pastel surroundings.

shots.narration: My morning starts with a hat I never asked for.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon bathroom, close view above a white sink, unmarked toothpaste tube.
shots.action: The plain toothpaste tube deposits a dollop onto the blue toothbrush, whose handle has big eyes and a small unimpressed mouth.
shots.mood: Bright morning light, absurdly fancy toothpaste peak, unimpressed expression.

shots.narration: [surprised] Easy! We're cleaning teeth, not scrubbing a frying pan.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon close-up of teeth and a cropped hand above a bathroom sink.
shots.action: The hand scrubs the blue toothbrush across the teeth, its big handle eyes wide and its small mouth puckered.
shots.mood: Energetic motion, toothpaste foam, comically alarmed expression.

shots.narration: Then comes my glamorous waterfall treatment.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon bathroom, chrome faucet over a clean white basin.
shots.action: Water streams over the blue toothbrush's bristles while its big handle eyes squint above a tiny grimacing mouth.
shots.mood: Sparkling droplets, cool blue reflections, mock luxury.

shots.narration: The rest of my day? Staring at the same tile.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon bathroom, ceramic toothbrush cup facing a plain peach tiled wall.
shots.action: The blue toothbrush with big eyes and a tiny flat mouth slowly tilts toward the blank wall.
shots.mood: Quiet daylight, empty counter, exaggerated boredom.

shots.narration: [sighs] Night arrives. Apparently, we're doing the mouth thing again.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, cosy 3D cartoon bathroom at night, warm vanity lighting, dark window.
shots.action: A cropped hand lifts the blue toothbrush from its cup, revealing its big weary eyes and small downturned mouth.
shots.mood: Warm amber light, resigned expression, familiar routine.

shots.narration: Same teeth. Same foam. Somehow, I'm still surprised.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, cosy 3D cartoon close-up of teeth and a cropped hand over the evening bathroom sink.
shots.action: The hand brushes the teeth with the blue toothbrush, whose big handle eyes bulge above its small startled mouth.
shots.mood: Fluffy toothpaste foam, warm lighting, comic disbelief.

shots.narration: Finally, bedtime. Standing up. In a cup.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, cosy 3D cartoon bathroom counter at night, ceramic cup beside a crumpled unmarked toothpaste tube.
shots.action: The blue toothbrush with big sleepy eyes and a small yawning mouth settles upright into the cup.
shots.mood: Soft amber shadows, quiet counter, exhausted relief.

shots.narration: [chuckles] Tomorrow, toothpaste explains why it always cracks under pressure.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, cosy 3D cartoon bathroom counter, toothbrush cup beside a heavily squeezed unmarked toothpaste tube.
shots.action: The blue toothbrush with big expressive eyes and a small mischievous smile tilts toward the flattened toothpaste tube.
shots.mood: Playful side-eye, warm bedtime lighting, visibly crumpled toothpaste tube.

episode.endHook: Next episode: toothpaste opens up about life under pressure.
episode.description: One toothbrush shares the exhausting truth about its morning and night routine. Two shifts, zero appreciation, and a very stressed toothpaste tube.
